results.title: GitHub - nixpt/api-drift: Snapshot a Rust crate's public API, diff versions, classify breaking changes, suggest downstream fixes — heading toward an embedded contract ledger
results.snippet: docs/DESIGN-embedded-ledger.md describes the next shape: any Rust project embeds api-drift as a dev-dependency test that keeps a committed snapshot and an append-only ledger of classified changes with migration notes, covering surfaces beyond pub items (protocol methods, enum variants, CLI flags), so a downstream can pin an upstream surface and learn, at its own call sites, what broke and what to edit. Tickets APIDRIFT-6 onward on the planning board (.jagent/planning/) track it.
